name: lem-hcb4-canonical-inverse
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb4-canonical-inverse — Canonical Ha inverse estimate: there are universal C_sp,inv < infinity and e_sp,inv > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_sp,inv has the special maps Ha^Q_{P,Q} and Ha^Q_{Q,P} completely bijective, with their amplified inverses differing from the corresponding canonical inverses by at most C_sp,inv*e.
